headline: Lumen Packaging cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Lumen Packaging lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Lumen Packaging Dayton facility
body: Workers at the Dayton facility of Lumen Packaging voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Lumen Packaging publishes annual sustainability report
body: Lumen Packaging released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Lumen Packaging opens new production line in Dayton
body: Lumen Packaging commissioned a new line at its Dayton site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Lumen Packaging faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Lumen Packaging. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Lumen Packaging executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Lumen Packaging as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.
